reading.body:
ElevenLabs operates a text-to-speech platform offering over 5,000 voices across 70+ languages, founded in 2022 and based in New York where 311 legal cases reference the jurisdiction.

The company's core offering is a voice synthesis model packaged as APIs and SDKs for enterprises, creators, and developers. This positions ElevenLabs in the inference layer of AI infrastructure. Voice synthesis is compute-intensive at scale, particularly when supporting high throughput and low latency across thousands of voice variants and dozens of languages. Each API call requires real-time model execution, which drives sustained demand for GPU capacity rather than one-time training costs.

The platform's main products, ElevenAgents and ElevenCreative, target customer experience and content creation respectively. These applications imply deployment at scale, where a single enterprise customer could generate thousands of daily inference requests. The emphasis on options optimized for consistency, latency, and emotional control suggests differentiation around inference quality and speed rather than model size.

The data flags voice cloning and consent risk as material to the company's profile. This reflects a regulatory exposure that is specific to voice as a modality, separate from the compute and power questions that constrain AI scaling more broadly. New York's 311 recorded cases in this jurisdiction indicate legal activity, though the data does not specify whether these are direct litigation, regulatory filings, or cases that reference the state incidentally.

profile_text.body:
ElevenLabs is a New York-based AI voice technology company founded in 2022. The company describes itself as building foundational models for voice and communication, starting with what it calls the first human-like voice model and extending into broader applications. Its platform offers an AI voice generator and a voice agents platform, providing access to more than 5,000 voices across 70 or more languages through APIs and SDKs.

The company's main product lines include ElevenAgents, aimed at customer experience use cases, and ElevenCreative, aimed at content creation. Its text-to-speech models are described by the company as independently rated as leading, with options optimized for consistency, latency, or emotional control, supporting 29 or more languages. The platform is marketed to enterprises, creators, and developers.

The site's held facts flag ElevenLabs under the Voice and Audio category, with a noted risk around voice cloning and issues of likeness and consent. The company has a notable legal exposure profile in New York, where 311 associated cases are recorded, though no specific litigation details are held in the current data.
